meta.title: Commodity Trend — $1,000 Challenge
meta.board_note: Commodities often trend when stocks and crypto chop — this bot rides whichever of gold/silver/oil/basket is trending, or stands aside.

strategy.name: Commodity Trend Rotation
strategy.rule: Hold the strongest 90-day-momentum commodity ETF above its own 200-day MA (GLD/SLV/USO/DBC); none above -> cash

thoughts: I'm holding DBC. Strongest commodity above its 200-day MA. I bought at $31.89; it's now $31.90 (+0.0% since I got in). My safety net: if the price falls to $28.88 (10% below its recent high), I sell automatically — no exceptions. Closest challenger on my list is USO, but it would need to look clearly better before I switch — jumping between positions too often just burns money on trades.
